```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(xgboost)
library(caret) 
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

#Import Dataset
should be M or W Master
```{r import data, echo=TRUE}
file_path <- file.choose()
final_data <- read.csv(file_path)
```

show correlations
``` {r target, echo=TRUE}
correlations <- final_data %>%
  select(-Win, -W_School, -L_School, -X) %>%  # Exclude the binary Win column itself
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ cor(. , final_data$Win, use = "complete.obs"))) %>% # Calculate correlation with 'Win'
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Correlation") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%  # Sort by absolute value of correlation (for magnitude)
  top_n(100, wt = abs(Correlation))

print(correlations)
```

correlation matrix
``` {r target, echo=TRUE}
# Keep only top 5 variables by absolute correlation
top5_correlations <- correlations %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(Correlation), n = 5)

# Plot
ggplot(top5_correlations, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Correlation), y = Correlation, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Variables Correlated with Win",
       x = "Variable",
       y = "Correlation")

```

#Feature Selection
Using XGBoost
```{r feature selection, echo=TRUE}
numeric_data <- final_data %>%
  select(-W_School, -L_School, -X)
df_with_na <- numeric_data %>% filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))
# 
# # View the result
# print(df_with_na)


# Convert predictors to a matrix
X <- as.matrix(select(numeric_data, -Win))

# Convert target variable to numeric
y <- as.numeric(numeric_data$Win)

# Check dimensions
print(dim(X))  # Should be (num_rows, num_features)
print(length(y))  # Should be num_rows
```
Selecting amount of features in slice
```{r feature selection, echo=TRUE}
# Create DMatrix (optimized format for XGBoost)
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X, label = y)

# Train the model
xgb_model <- xgboost(data = dtrain, 
                     nrounds = 300,  
                     objective = "binary:logistic",  
                     eval_metric = "logloss",  
                     max_depth = 6,  
                     eta = 0.1)

# Get feature importance
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model)

# View top 40 most important features
top_features <- importance_matrix %>%
  arrange(desc(Gain)) %>%
  slice(1:40) %>%
  pull(Feature)

# Select only top features for final model
selected_data <- numeric_data %>%
  select(all_of(top_features), Win)

```
verifying results
```{r feature selection, echo=TRUE}
print(importance_matrix)
print(dim(selected_data))  # Should show (num_rows, 51) since 50 features + Win
```

#Train Final Model with selected features
```{r final model, echo=TRUE}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(64)

# Create a 80/20 train-test split
train_index <- createDataPartition(selected_data$Win, p = 0.9, list = FALSE)

train_data <- selected_data[train_index, ]
test_data <- selected_data[-train_index, ]

# Extract features (X) and target (y) for both train and test sets
X_train <- as.matrix(select(train_data, -Win))
y_train <- as.numeric(train_data$Win)

X_test <- as.matrix(select(test_data, -Win))
y_test <- as.numeric(test_data$Win)

# Convert training data into XGBoost DMatrix format
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)

# Train the model
xgb_model <- xgboost(data = dtrain, 
                     nrounds = 200,  #change this
                     objective = "binary:logistic",  
                     eval_metric = "logloss",  
                     max_depth = 3,  
                     eta = 0.05)

# Convert test set into XGBoost DMatrix
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test)

# Get predicted probabilities (between 0 and 1)
y_pred_prob <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)

# Convert probabilities to binary class (threshold = 0.5)
y_pred <- ifelse(y_pred_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Load required libraries for evaluation
library(caret)

# Create a confusion matrix
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(factor(y_pred), factor(y_test))

# Print accuracy and other metrics
print(conf_matrix)


```

#Predict on 2025 data
should be M or W 2025
```{r final model, echo=TRUE}
file_path <- file.choose()
W2025 <- read.csv(file_path) #Change this

M_or_W <- "WNCAATourneySeeds.csv" #Change this
read_path <- paste0("C:/Users/Evan/Documents/Kaggle/march-machine-learning-mania-2025/", M_or_W)
seed <- read.csv(read_path)
seed <- seed %>%
   mutate(Seed = str_sub(Seed,2) %>% 
            str_replace("[ab]$", "")) %>%
  filter(Season == 2025)

```
format the 2025 data the same
##Mens Format
```{r final model, echo=TRUE}
szn <- "2025"
M2025 <- M2025 %>% mutate(Season = szn) %>%
  mutate(
    Kenpom._.NetRtg = as.numeric(Kenpom._.NetRtg),
    School.Advanced._.Pace = as.numeric(School.Advanced._.Pace)
  ) %>%
  mutate(AVG_Score_Margin = (Points._.Tm. - Points._.Opp.) / Overall._.G) %>%
  mutate(FG_pct_Difference = Totals._.FG. - Opponent._.FG.) %>%
  mutate(eFG_pct_Difference = School.Advanced._.eFG. - Opponent.Advanced._.eFG.) %>%
  mutate(Rebound_Margin = School.Advanced._.TRB. - Opponent.Advanced._.TRB.) %>%
  mutate(TO_Margin = School.Advanced._.TOV. - Opponent.Advanced._.TOV.) %>%
  mutate(TriangleEXC = Kenpom._.NetRtg * School.Advanced._.Pace * .01) %>%
  mutate(Season = as.integer(Season))

combined_seeds <- M2025 %>%
  left_join(select(seed, TeamID, Seed, Season), by = c("ID" = "TeamID", "Season"))
combined_seeds <- combined_seeds %>%
  filter(!is.na(Seed))

# Step 1: Create all unique matchups (each team faces each other once)
matchups <- combined_seeds %>%
  select(Season, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(WTeamID = ID) %>%
  left_join(
    combined_seeds %>% select(Season, ID) %>% distinct() %>% rename(LTeamID = ID),
    by = "Season"
  ) %>%
  filter(WTeamID < LTeamID)  # Avoid duplicate matchups (1001 vs. 1002 but not 1002 vs. 1001)

# Step 2: Merge in team statistics (prefix W_ and L_ to team stats)
combined <- matchups %>%
  left_join(combined_seeds, by = c("Season", "WTeamID" = "ID")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("W_", .), .cols = -c(Season, WTeamID, LTeamID)) %>%
  left_join(combined_seeds, by = c("Season", "LTeamID" = "ID")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("L_", .), .cols = -c(Season, WTeamID, LTeamID, starts_with("W_")))

combined <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(W_Seed)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(L_Seed)) %>%
  mutate(W_Seed = as.integer(W_Seed)) %>%
  mutate(L_Seed = as.integer(L_Seed))
combined_diff <- combined %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("W_") & !matches("W_School"), 
                ~ . - get(str_replace(cur_column(), "W_", "L_")), 
                .names = "diff_{.col}"))
# tourney_flipped <- combined_diff %>%
#   rename_with(~str_replace(., "W_", "temp_"), starts_with("W_")) %>%
#   rename_with(~str_replace(., "L_", "W_"), starts_with("L_")) %>%
#   rename_with(~str_replace(., "temp_", "L_"), starts_with("temp_")) %>%
#   mutate(across(starts_with("W_") & !matches("W_School"), ~ . - get(str_replace(cur_column(), "W_", "L_")), .names = "diff_{.col}"))

final_data <- combined_diff #bind_rows(combined_diff, tourney_flipped)

numeric_data <- final_data %>%
  select(-W_School, -L_School)
```

##Womens Format
```{r final model, echo=TRUE}
szn <- "2025"
W2025 <- W2025 %>% mutate(Season = szn) %>%
  mutate(AVG_Score_Margin = (Points_Tm. - Points_Opp.) / Overall_G) %>%
  mutate(FG_pct_Difference = Totals_FG. - Opponent_FG.) %>%
  mutate(eFG_pct_Difference = School.Advanced_eFG. - Opponent.Advanced_eFG.) %>%
  mutate(Rebound_Margin = School.Advanced_TRB. - Opponent.Advanced_TRB.) %>%
  mutate(TO_Margin = School.Advanced_TOV. - Opponent.Advanced_TOV.) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-School), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.)))

combined_seeds <- W2025 %>%
  left_join(select(seed, TeamID, Seed, Season), by = c("ID" = "TeamID", "Season"))
combined_seeds <- combined_seeds %>%
  filter(!is.na(Seed))

# Step 1: Create all unique matchups (each team faces each other once)
matchups <- combined_seeds %>%
  select(Season, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(WTeamID = ID) %>%
  left_join(
    combined_seeds %>% select(Season, ID) %>% distinct() %>% rename(LTeamID = ID),
    by = "Season"
  ) %>%
  filter(WTeamID < LTeamID)  # Avoid duplicate matchups (1001 vs. 1002 but not 1002 vs. 1001)

# Step 2: Merge in team statistics (prefix W_ and L_ to team stats)
combined <- matchups %>%
  left_join(combined_seeds, by = c("Season", "WTeamID" = "ID")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("W_", .), .cols = -c(Season, WTeamID, LTeamID)) %>%
  left_join(combined_seeds, by = c("Season", "LTeamID" = "ID")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("L_", .), .cols = -c(Season, WTeamID, LTeamID, starts_with("W_")))

combined <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(W_Seed)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(L_Seed)) %>%
  mutate(W_Seed = as.integer(W_Seed)) %>%
  mutate(L_Seed = as.integer(L_Seed))
combined_diff <- combined %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("W_") & !matches("W_School"), 
                ~ . - get(str_replace(cur_column(), "W_", "L_")), 
                .names = "diff_{.col}"))
# tourney_flipped <- combined_diff %>%
#   rename_with(~str_replace(., "W_", "temp_"), starts_with("W_")) %>%
#   rename_with(~str_replace(., "L_", "W_"), starts_with("L_")) %>%
#   rename_with(~str_replace(., "temp_", "L_"), starts_with("temp_")) %>%
#   mutate(across(starts_with("W_") & !matches("W_School"), ~ . - get(str_replace(cur_column(), "W_", "L_")), .names = "diff_{.col}"))

final_data <- combined_diff #bind_rows(combined_diff, tourney_flipped)

numeric_data <- final_data %>%
  select(-W_School, -L_School)
```

#Predict new data
```{r final model, echo=TRUE}

# Select only the same features used in training
new_data_prepped <- numeric_data %>%
  select(all_of(top_features))  # Use the top 50 features from training

# Convert to matrix for XGBoost
X_real <- as.matrix(new_data_prepped)

# Convert real dataset to DMatrix format
dreal <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_real)

# Generate predictions (probabilities between 0 and 1)
predicted_probabilities <- predict(xgb_model, dreal)

# Convert probabilities to binary outcomes (Win = 1, Lose = 0)
predicted_classes <- ifelse(predicted_probabilities > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Add predictions to the original dataset
new_data_results <- numeric_data %>%
  mutate(Predicted_Win = predicted_classes, Win_Probability = predicted_probabilities)

```
#Export Final Data
```{r final model, echo=TRUE}
export2025 <- new_data_results %>% select(WTeamID, LTeamID, Win_Probability)  %>%
   mutate(W_School = final_data$W_School,
          L_School = final_data$L_School)

# Save results to a CSV file
save_name <- "XGBoostW40.csv"
save_path <- paste0("C:/Users/Evan/Documents/Kaggle/march-machine-learning-mania-2025/My stats/", save_name)
write.csv(export2025,save_path,row.names = TRUE)
```
